welc.guide.other: If you don't know where to start, the Administrator Guide is definitely a good read!

welc.intro.other: This is your dashboard for managing the file service. Using the left menu you can create workspaces and users, check all events that happened on the platform, and manage configurations and plugins.

welc.import.other: If you are currently running a legacy installation, please be aware that legacy will be considered End-Of-Life at the end of 2019. You can use the Import Tool to migrate all data to the file service.

welc.subtitle.other: The place to administrate and monitor the activity of your platform
